name: Voidrift Sense
description: Feel where distance has been thinned to nothing and a crossing could be opened.

name: Gap Step
description: Step into a fold of emptiness and out again a few paces off.

name: Voidspace Jab
description: Jab at a point and have the blow arrive from the folded side.

name: Null Fold
description: Fold the space before the body so that a blow is thrown past to the side.

name: Folded Null
description: Fold a null round a caster so that every technique turns back on itself.

name: Rift Lock
description: Pin a foe inside a rift of emptiness so the foe cannot step beyond it.

name: Voidspace Purge
description: Fold a curse or taint out of an ally into a space where it cannot return.

name: Voidfold Step
description: Fold the ground behind the user and arrive well ahead of the pace of a normal step.

name: Rift Annul
description: Open a rift before a great technique and let it fall through to nowhere.

name: Spatial Collapse
description: Collapse a wide stretch of space inward and draw all in it toward the centre.

name: Voidspace Phase
description: Fold space through a solid barrier and step out on the far side.

name: Dimensional Null
description: streams: Void + Space. Fuse the absence of the void with the emptiness that makes distance and tear a null into the field where no force or step can cross.

name: Dead Quiet
description: Spread a quiet like the quiet of a finished life over the near air.

name: Ending Sense
description: Feel how near each body in reach stands to the end of its strength.

name: Cessation Touch
description: Touch a limb and bring its motion to a stop for a moment.

name: Stilled Ward
description: Hold a ward of perfect stillness in which no blow can complete its motion.

name: Cessation Seal
description: Bring the qi of a foe to a halt and seal it still.

name: Final Drain
description: Drain the last strength of a failing foe down into silence.

name: Endless Purge
description: End a curse or a rot in an ally and leave only the quiet of healthy flesh.

name: Quiet End
description: Strike a staggering foe with a blow that settles the matter without a sound.

name: Silent Annul
description: End a great technique in mid-air and let it fade into silence.

name: Ceasing Wave
description: Roll a wave that brings the strength of all it passes to a stop.

name: Ending Hush
description: Lay a final hush on the field in which every foe finds it hard to rise.

name: Cessation Erasure
description: Bring the living force of a target to an end past any ward.

name: Void Obliteration
description: streams: Void + Death. Fuse the void's nothing with the end of life into one silence that stops motion and breath in all it touches.

name: Cessation Verdict
description: streams: Void + Death. Pass a quiet verdict on a single foe so that strength and spirit both go out together and leave nothing behind.
